body.statement: In the pooled ridge model on demand lags 1-4 and 4/13-week rolling means (alpha=1.0, no log transform, no trend/category terms, no series-mean centering), adding the known-in-advance count of promotion weeks falling in the 4-week forecast window (treatment: promo=true) reduces relative WAPE of the next-4-week unit sum by at least 1.0% (SESOI) versus the identical model without that feature (comparator: promo=false), as estimated by the two-way (series x rolling-origin) bootstrap mean difference in relative WAPE under Design C (58 rolling origins, weeks 110-338, 364-week history).
body.estimand: relative WAPE reduction, next-4-week sum, two-way bootstrap
body.kills_if: The two-way bootstrap 97.5% CI for the relative WAPE reduction (treatment vs comparator) includes 0 or its lower bound is below the 1.0% SESOI, or the point estimate is negative or null (e.g., promotion-week-count feature receives ~0 ridge weight across resamples), or the placebo control shows a non-null effect, or the positive control fails to show its expected effect — any of these drops the idea at alpha=0.025 per test.
